<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Team Veveyse – Formation attractive pour nos juniors</title>
<meta name="description" content="Team Veveyse : structure de formation régionale du football juniors de la Veveyse.">
<script>if(!matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){document.documentElement.className='js lk';window.go=function(){var h=document.documentElement;h.classList.remove('lk');h.classList.add('go');var p=document.getElementById('pre');if(p)p.classList.add('out');var a=document.querySelector('.hero h1'),b=document.querySelector('.hero .tg');if(a)a.classList.add('in');if(b)b.classList.add('in')};setTimeout(go,3800)}</script>
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wdth,wght@62..125,400..900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--l-boss:url(data:image/webp;base64,);--l-cps:url(data:image/webp;base64,);--l-chatel:url(data:image/webp;base64,);--l-sem:url(data:image/webp;base64,);--crest:url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,");--navy:#0E2A52;--blue:#1B5FAF;--sky:#5DB0EA;--skyl:#E8F3FC;--bg:#fff;--soft:#F3F6FA;--ink:#0F1B2D;--mut:#5A6B80;--line:#DDE5EE;--card:#fff;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0B1320;--soft:#101B2D;--ink:#EAF1F8;--mut:#9AAEC4;--line:#1F3049;--card:#12203A;--skyl:#16304F}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0B1320;--soft:#101B2D;--ink:#EAF1F8;--mut:#9AAEC4;--line:#1F3049;--card:#12203A;--skyl:#16304F}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:calc(90px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));height:100%}
body{font-family:Archivo,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);line-height:1.6;min-height:100%}
h1,h2,h3,.h{font-stretch:112%;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.01em}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.crest{background:var(--crest) center/contain no-repeat;aspect-ratio:300/392}
.bar{background:var(--navy);color:#BFD3EA;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.bar .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;height:36px;align-items:center}
.bar a:hover{color:#fff}.bar nav{display:flex;gap:22px}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:30;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:78px;gap:20px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.brand .crest{width:42px}
.brand b{display:block;font-stretch:112%;font-weight:800;font-size:19px;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1}
.brand small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut)}
.menu{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}
.menu a{padding:10px 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;position:relative}
.menu a:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:4px;height:3px;background:var(--sky);transform:scaleX(0);transition:.25s;transform-origin:left}
.menu a:hover:after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.menu a.cta{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;margin-left:10px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:3px}.menu a.cta:after{display:none}.menu a.cta:hover{background:var(--navy)}
.hero{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--navy) 0%,#154B8D 55%,#2F86CC 100%);color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:84px 0 130px}
.hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;right:6%;top:50%;width:640px;height:640px;margin-top:-320px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:calc(6% + 319px);top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:2}
.tg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#BFE0F8}
.tg:before{content:"";width:34px;height:4px;background:var(--sky)}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(40px,6.4vw,84px);margin:22px 0 22px}
.hero p{max-width:480px;color:#D3E6F7;font-size:18px}
.btns{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:36px}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:15px 30px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:3px;border:2px solid #fff;transition:.25s}
.btn.p{background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}.btn.p:hover{background:var(--skyl)}
.btn.o{color:#fff}.btn.o:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.hero .crest{width:clamp(200px,25vw,300px);justify-self:center;filter:drop-shadow(0 24px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35))}
.quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:-60px;position:relative;z-index:5}
.quick a{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:4px solid var(--sky);padding:24px;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(14,42,82,.12);transition:.25s;display:block}
.quick a:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-top-color:var(--blue)}
.quick b{display:block;font-stretch:112%;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:18px}.quick span{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.quick i{display:block;font-style:normal;color:var(--blue);font-weight:800;margin-top:10px}
section{padding:96px 0}.alt{background:var(--soft)}
.t{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:38px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.t .tg{color:var(--blue)}.t .tg:before{background:var(--sky)}
h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4.2vw,48px);margin-top:12px}
.lead{color:var(--mut);max-width:620px;font-size:17px}
.hm{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.7fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}.news{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}.nw:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}.ag{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:30px;position:sticky;top:110px}.ag h3{font-size:26px;margin:12px 0 18px}.ev{display:flex;gap:16px;padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15)}.dt{background:var(--sky);color:var(--navy);width:58px;height:62px;border-radius:3px;flex:none;display:grid;place-content:center;text-align:center;line-height:1}.dt b{font-size:24px;font-weight:800}.dt span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:700}.ev b{display:block}.ev div:last-child span{font-size:13px;color:#BFD3EA}.em{color:#BFD3EA;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);padding-top:16px}
.nw{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:.25s}
.nw:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(14,42,82,.14)}
.nw .ph{height:200px;background:var(--crest) 50% 50%/auto 62% no-repeat,linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),#2F86CC)}
.nw:first-child .ph{height:250px}
.nw .b{padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;flex:1}
.nw time{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}
.nw h3{font-size:20px;line-height:1.15;flex:1;text-transform:none;font-stretch:100%;font-weight:800}.nw:first-child h3{font-size:26px}
.more{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:60px;align-items:start}
.about p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:16px}.about p:first-of-type{margin-top:0;font-size:18px;color:var(--ink)}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}
.stat{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;padding:26px 20px;text-align:center}
.stat b{display:block;font-stretch:112%;font-weight:800;font-size:46px;color:var(--blue);line-height:1}.stat span{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut)}
.cl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:50px}
.cl a{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;padding:22px 24px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;transition:.25s}
.cl a:hover{border-color:var(--sky);transform:translateY(-3px)}.cl b{font-stretch:106%;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:15px;line-height:1.2}.cl i{font-style:normal;color:var(--sky);font-weight:800;font-size:20px}
.sub{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--blue);margin:44px 0 16px}.sub:first-of-type{margin-top:34px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:16px}
.pc{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;padding:22px;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center}
.av{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--sky));color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-stretch:112%;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;flex:none}
.pc b{display:block;font-weight:700}.pc span{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut);line-height:1.4;display:block}
.pills{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:26px}
.pills button{font:700 13px Archivo,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.pills button:hover{border-color:var(--sky)}.pills button.on{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.tc{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;padding:24px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.tc:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:5px;background:var(--sky)}
.tc small{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}
.tc h3{font-size:30px;margin:8px 0 4px}.tc span{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.cal{margin-top:20px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}
a.tc:hover{border-color:var(--sky);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(14,42,82,.12)}.cal.off{color:var(--mut)}
.shop{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--navy),#1B5FAF);color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:54px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.shop:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-60px;width:300px;height:300px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.shop h2{margin:0}.shop p{color:#CFE3F6;margin-top:10px;max-width:460px}.shop .btn{position:relative;z-index:2}
.pn{margin-top:-90px;position:relative;z-index:5}.spons{background:#fff;color:#0F1B2D;padding:42px 0 46px;border-top:5px solid var(--sky);border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 22px 48px rgba(14,42,82,.2);overflow:hidden}.sh{font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,40px);text-align:center;margin:0;color:#0F1B2D}.ss{text-align:center;color:#5A6B80;margin:8px 0 30px;padding:0 20px}

.track{display:flex;gap:72px;width:max-content;animation:sc 38s linear infinite;align-items:center}
.spons:hover .track{animation-play-state:paused}
.track a,.track div{height:120px;width:230px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.track img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
@keyframes sc{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.track{animation:none}}
.ct{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:50px;align-items:start}
.ln{padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.ln b{display:block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut);font-weight:700}
.join{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start}
.join .crest{width:64px}.join h3{font-size:30px}.join p{color:#C2D7EC}
footer{background:var(--navy);color:#9FB6D1;padding:36px 0;font-size:13px}
footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}footer .crest{width:34px}
@media (max-width:900px){.menu a:not(.cta){display:none}.bar nav{display:none}.hero .wrap,.about,.ct,.news,.hm{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ag{position:static}.pn{margin-top:-76px}.hero{padding:56px 0 110px}.hero .crest{justify-self:start;width:150px}.hero:before,.hero:after{display:none}.quick{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}section{padding:64px 0}.shop{padding:34px 24px}}
.lg{display:block;background:center/contain no-repeat;flex:none}.lg-boss{background-image:var(--l-boss)}.lg-cps{background-image:var(--l-cps)}.lg-chatel{background-image:var(--l-chatel)}.lg-sem{background-image:var(--l-sem)}
.lg.mono{background:var(--skyl);color:var(--blue);display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.cl .lg{width:56px;height:56px}.cl b{flex:1}
.tc .lg{position:absolute;right:18px;top:18px;width:46px;height:46px}.tc h3{padding-right:58px}
.slot{border:2px dashed #C5D3E2;border-radius:6px;color:#8EA2B8;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}
.track.still{animation:none;width:auto;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:20px;padding:0 24px}
.track.still .slot{height:110px;width:210px}
.sc{text-align:center;margin-top:30px}.spons .btn.p{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}.spons .btn.p:hover{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy)}
.empty{padding:52px 32px;text-align:center;align-items:center;border-style:dashed}.empty:hover{transform:none;box-shadow:none}
.empty .crest{width:60px;margin-bottom:14px}.empty h3{font-size:22px;font-stretch:112%;text-transform:uppercase;flex:none}.empty p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:8px}

.prog{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;z-index:60;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--sky),var(--blue));transform:scaleX(var(--p,0));transform-origin:0 50%}
.nav{transition:height .3s}header{transition:box-shadow .3s}header.sc{box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(14,42,82,.16)}header.sc .nav{height:62px}
.menu a.act{color:var(--blue)}.menu a.act:after{transform:scaleX(1)}.menu a.cta.act{color:#fff}
.hero:before,.hero:after{display:none}
.pitch{position:absolute;top:-40px;left:-40px;width:calc(100% + 80px);height:calc(100% + 80px);pointer-events:none}
.cw{justify-self:center}
.band{overflow:hidden;background:var(--navy);padding:30px 0;white-space:nowrap}
.bt{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:56px;font-stretch:125%;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(44px,7.5vw,96px);line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.5);will-change:transform}
.bt span:nth-child(even){color:var(--sky);-webkit-text-stroke:0}
.bt span:after{content:"◆";margin-left:56px;font-size:.3em;vertical-align:middle;color:var(--sky);-webkit-text-stroke:0}
.tc,.pc{transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.w{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:bottom;padding:.05em 0 .12em;margin:-.05em 0 -.12em}.w>span{display:inline-block}
.js .sp .w>span{transform:translateY(115%);transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);transition-delay:calc(var(--i)*70ms + var(--b,0ms))}
.js .sp.in .w>span{transform:none}
.js .hi{opacity:0;animation:fu 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) forwards;animation-delay:calc(var(--d,0)*120ms + 450ms)}
@keyframes fu{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.js .pitch g *{stroke-dasharray:1;stroke-dashoffset:1;animation:dr 2.8s .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) forwards}
.js .pitch circle[r="6"]{stroke-dasharray:none;stroke-dashoffset:0;opacity:0;animation:fu .6s 1.6s forwards}
@keyframes dr{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
.js .rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(36px);transition:opacity .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);transition-delay:calc(var(--d,0)*80ms)}
.js .rv.l{transform:translateX(-44px)}.js .rv.r{transform:translateX(44px)}.js .rv.z{transform:translateY(24px) scale(.94)}
.js .rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.js .tg:before{width:0;transition:width .9s .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.js .tg.in:before,.js .in .tg:before{width:34px}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){
.hero{background-size:170% 170%;animation:gs 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes gs{to{background-position:100% 100%}}
.empty .crest,.join .crest{animation:fl 5s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes fl{50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}
.slot{animation:pl 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:calc(var(--d,0)*.4s)}@keyframes pl{50%{border-color:var(--sky);color:var(--sky)}}}
@media (max-width:900px){.cw{justify-self:start}.hero .crest{width:150px}.brand small{display:none}.brand b{font-size:16px;white-space:nowrap}.brand .crest{width:36px}}

.pre{display:none}
.js .pre{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,#17427a,var(--navy) 70%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:22px;color:#fff;clip-path:inset(0)}
.pre .crest{width:110px;animation:pi 1.3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 30px rgba(93,176,234,.5))}
@keyframes pi{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.5) rotateY(100deg)}}
.pre b{font-stretch:125%;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.32em;font-size:13px;animation:fu .8s .5s both}
.ld{width:170px;height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.ld:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--sky);transform:translateX(-100%);animation:ldg 1.7s .2s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.2,1) forwards}
@keyframes ldg{to{transform:none}}
.pre.out{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);visibility:hidden;transition:clip-path .95s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1),visibility 0s .98s}
html.lk,html.lk body{overflow:hidden}
.js .hi,.js .pitch g *{animation-play-state:paused}.go .hi,.go .pitch g *{animation-play-state:running}
.cw{position:relative;perspective:900px}
.cw:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-14%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(93,176,234,.5),transparent 66%);animation:hl 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes hl{from{opacity:.55;transform:scale(.92)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.06)}}
#hc{position:relative;z-index:1;transform-style:preserve-3d}
#hc:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 38%,rgba(255,255,255,.8) 50%,transparent 62%) 130% 0/250% 100% no-repeat;-webkit-mask:var(--crest) center/contain no-repeat;mask:var(--crest) center/contain no-repeat;animation:shn 4.8s 2.8s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes shn{0%{background-position:130% 0}55%,100%{background-position:-70% 0}}
@media (min-width:901px){
.js #equipes{padding:0}
.js .hzs{position:sticky;top:78px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:30px 0}
.js .hzs #teams{display:flex;width:max-content;gap:16px;padding:6px max(24px,calc((100vw - 1132px)/2)) 24px;will-change:transform}
.js .hzs .tc{width:290px;flex:none}
.js .hzs>.wrap{width:100%}
}
.js .story .tg:before{width:34px}
.story{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:96px 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.sg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:50px;align-items:center}
.story h2{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(32px,4.4vw,58px);margin:18px 0 0}
.story p{color:#C9DCEF;max-width:470px;margin-top:18px;font-size:18px}
.stage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;width:100%;max-width:420px;justify-self:center;--k:1}
.sl{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:18px;aspect-ratio:1;box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.28);transition:transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,1.25,.35,1),opacity .6s;transition-delay:calc(var(--i)*150ms)}
.sl .lg{width:100%;height:100%}
.js .story:not(.in) .sl{opacity:0;transform:translate(calc(var(--x)*var(--k)),calc(var(--y)*var(--k))) rotate(var(--r)) scale(.4)}
@media (max-width:900px){.sg{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stage{--k:.35}}
.co{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;padding:22px;position:relative;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.co:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:5px;background:var(--sky)}
.co:hover{border-color:var(--sky);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(14,42,82,.12)}
.co small{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}
.co .r{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-top:14px}.co .av{width:42px;height:42px;font-size:14px}
.co b{display:block;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3}.co span{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
</style>
</head>

<div class="hero" id="top"><svg class="pitch" viewBox="0 0 1200 600" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" aria-hidden="true"><g fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2" stroke-opacity=".16"><circle cx="880" cy="300" r="170" pathLength="1"/><line x1="880" y1="-20" x2="880" y2="620" pathLength="1"/><rect x="1000" y="160" width="260" height="280" pathLength="1"/><rect x="1100" y="232" width="160" height="136" pathLength="1"/><rect x="-60" y="160" width="260" height="280" pathLength="1"/><circle cx="880" cy="300" r="6" fill="#fff" stroke="none"/></g></svg><div class="wrap">

<p class="hi" style="--d:3">Une formation attractive pour nos juniors, au sein de leurs clubs de cœur.</p>
<div class="btns hi" style="--d:4"><a class="btn p" href="#equipes">Voir les équipes</a><a class="btn o" href="#presentation">Découvrir le Team</a></div></div>

<section class="alt" id="presentation"><div class="wrap">
<div class="about">
<div><span class="tg" style="color:var(--blue)">Présentation</span><h2 style="margin-bottom:24px">Une structure de formation régionale</h2>
<p>Team Veveyse est une structure de formation régionale pour footballeurs amateurs et élites. Elle regroupe quatre clubs de la Veveyse.</p>
<p>Cette structure rassemble forces et compétences pour améliorer la formation des jeunes les plus talentueux. Chaque club y apporte sa culture, son expérience et partage son savoir-faire avec les autres membres.</p>
<p>Les footballeurs prometteurs de la Veveyse sont répartis dans les équipes de la structure et bénéficient du travail de formateurs reconnus et qualifiés.</p></div>
<div><div class="stats"><div class="stat"><b class="cnt" data-to="4">4</b><span>Clubs</span></div><div class="stat"><b id="nt" class="cnt">–</b><span>Équipes</span></div></div>
<p style="margin-top:22px">Le Team Veveyse a trouvé son identité bleu ciel et s’appuie sur des partenaires régionaux pour gagner en visibilité. Merci de votre intérêt et de votre soutien !</p></div>
</div>
<div class="cl">

</div>

<div class="co"><small>Juniors D1 Bossonnens</small><div class="r"><div class="av">SM</div><div><b>Sébastien Monnard</b><span>Entraîneur</span></div></div><div class="r"><div class="av">ND</div><div><b>Nola Durand</b><span>Assistante</span></div></div></div>

</div></section>

Écrivez-nous.</p><div class="btns" style="margin:6px 0 0"><a class="btn p" href="mailto:info@teamveveyse.ch">Nous écrire</a><a class="btn o" href="https://www.facebook.com/TeamVeveyse/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Facebook</a></div></div>

<script>
/* Renseigner "aff" avec le lien du calendrier AFF de chaque équipe */
var TEAMS=[
{n:'Juniors B1',c:'Bossonnens',aff:'https://matchcenter.aff-ffv.ch/default.aspx?v=701&oid=13&lng=2&t=67721&a=trr'},
{n:'Juniors C',c:'Bossonnens',aff:'https://matchcenter.aff-ffv.ch/default.aspx?v=701&oid=13&lng=2&t=32955&a=trr'},
{n:'Juniors D9-1',c:'Bossonnens',aff:'https://matchcenter.aff-ffv.ch/default.aspx?v=701&oid=13&lng=2&t=75709&a=trr'},
{n:'Juniors D9-2',c:'Bossonnens',aff:'https://matchcenter.aff-ffv.ch/default.aspx?v=701&oid=13&lng=2&t=79091&a=trr'},
{n:'Juniors B Promo',c:'Semsales',aff:'https://matchcenter.aff-ffv.ch/default.aspx?v=769&oid=13&lng=2&t=43603&a=trr'},
{n:'Juniors C',c:'Semsales',aff:'https://matchcenter.aff-ffv.ch/default.aspx?v=769&oid=13&lng=2&t=67114&a=trr'},
{n:'Juniors D9',c:'Semsales',aff:'https://matchcenter.aff-ffv.ch/default.aspx?v=769&oid=13&lng=2&t=77359&a=trr'},
{n:'Juniors A1',c:'Châtel-St-Denis',aff:'https://matchcenter.aff-ffv.ch/default.aspx?v=707&oid=13&lng=2&t=79095&a=trr'},
{n:'Juniors Féminines FF 17',c:'Châtel-St-Denis',aff:'https://matchcenter.aff-ffv.ch/default.aspx?v=707&oid=13&lng=2&t=76919&a=trr'},
{n:'Juniors D9',c:'Châtel-St-Denis',aff:'https://matchcenter.aff-ffv.ch/default.aspx?v=707&oid=13&lng=2&t=79514&a=trr'},
{n:'Juniors D9',c:'CPS',aff:'https://matchcenter.aff-ffv.ch/default.aspx?v=740&oid=13&lng=2&t=33168&a=trr'},
{n:'Juniors C Promo',c:'CPS',aff:'https://matchcenter.aff-ffv.ch/default.aspx?v=740&oid=13&lng=2&t=79505&a=trr'}];
/* Agenda : ajouter des événements, ex. {d:'14',m:'JUIN',t:'Titre',l:'Lieu'} */
var EVENTS=[];
document.getElementById('ag').innerHTML=EVENTS.length?EVENTS.map(function(e){return '<div class="ev"><div class="dt"><b>'+e.d+'</b><span>'+e.m+'</span></div><div><b>'+e.t+'</b><span>'+e.l+'</span></div></div>'}).join(''):'<p class="em">Les prochains événements du Team seront annoncés ici.</p>';
var nt=document.getElementById('nt');nt.textContent=TEAMS.length;nt.dataset.to=TEAMS.length;
var cur='Toutes',cats=['Toutes'];TEAMS.forEach(function(t){if(cats.indexOf(t.c)<0)cats.push(t.c)});
function draw(){
document.getElementById('pills').innerHTML=cats.map(function(k){return '<button class="'+(k===cur?'on':'')+'" data-k="'+k+'">'+k+'</button>'}).join('');
document.getElementById('teams').innerHTML=TEAMS.filter(function(t){return cur==='Toutes'||t.c===cur}).map(function(t){
var LG={'Bossonnens':'lg-boss','Semsales':'lg-sem','Châtel-St-Denis':'lg-chatel','CPS':'lg-cps'};var lg=LG[t.c]?'<span class="lg '+LG[t.c]+'"></span>':'';
var x=lg+'<small>'+(t.c==='CPS'?'FC CPS':'FC '+t.c)+'</small><h3>'+t.n+'</h3>';
return t.aff?'<a class="tc" href="'+t.aff+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">'+x+'<div class="cal">Calendrier AFF ↗</div></a>':'<div class="tc">'+x+'<div class="cal off">Calendrier à venir</div></div>';}).join('');
}
document.getElementById('pills').addEventListener('click',function(e){var k=e.target.getAttribute('data-k');if(k){cur=k;draw()}});
draw();
/* Sponsors : ajouter {n:'Nom',src:'chemin/logo.png',url:'https://...'} */
var SPONSORS=[];
var tr=document.getElementById('track');
if(SPONSORS.length){tr.innerHTML=SPONSORS.map(function(p){var i='<img alt="'+p.n+'" src="'+p.src+'">';return p.url?'<a href="'+p.url+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">'+i+'</a>':'<div>'+i+'</div>'}).join('');document.getElementById('sc').style.display='none';tr.innerHTML+=tr.innerHTML}
else{var sl='<div class="slot">Votre logo ici</div>';tr.innerHTML=sl+sl+sl+sl+sl+sl;tr.innerHTML+=tr.innerHTML}

/* Animations au défilement */
(function(){
var D=document,H=D.documentElement;
if(!H.classList.contains('js')){D.querySelectorAll('.cnt').forEach(function(e){e.textContent=e.dataset.to||e.textContent});return}
function split(el){var t=el.textContent.trim();el.setAttribute('aria-label',t);el.innerHTML=t.split(/\s+/).map(function(w,i){return '<span class="w" aria-hidden="true"><span style="--i:'+i+'">'+w+'</span></span>'}).join(' ')}
function count(el){var to=+el.dataset.to,t0=null;function f(t){if(!t0)t0=t;var p=Math.min((t-t0)/1400,1);el.textContent=Math.round(to*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3)));if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f)}requestAnimationFrame(f)}
var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(!e.isIntersecting)return;var el=e.target;io.unobserve(el);el.classList.add('in');if(el.classList.contains('cnt'))count(el);
if(el.classList.contains('rv')&&!el.classList.contains('t'))setTimeout(function(){el.classList.remove('rv','in','l','r','z')},1600)})},{threshold:.12,rootMargin:'0px 0px -6% 0px'});
function mark(sel,cls){D.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(function(el,i){if(el.classList.contains('rv'))return;el.classList.add('rv');if(cls)el.classList.add(cls);el.style.setProperty('--d',i%6);io.observe(el)})}
D.querySelectorAll('h2').forEach(function(h){if(h.closest('.stp'))return;split(h);h.classList.add('sp');io.observe(h)});
split(D.querySelector('.hero h1'));
mark('.t');mark('.about>div:first-child','l');mark('.about>div:last-child','r');mark('.stat','z');mark('.cl a');mark('.sub');mark('.pc','z');mark('.pills');mark('.nw');mark('.ag','r');mark('.shop','z');mark('.spons','z');mark('.ln','l');mark('.join','r');mark('.story p');mark('.co','z');mark('#teams .tc','z');
D.querySelectorAll('.cnt').forEach(function(e){e.dataset.to=e.dataset.to||e.textContent;e.textContent=0;io.observe(e)});
var mob=matchMedia('(max-width:900px)'),hz=D.getElementById('hz'),hzs=D.getElementById('hzs'),trk=D.getElementById('teams'),story=D.getElementById('story');new IntersectionObserver(function(es,o){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){story.classList.add('in');o.disconnect()}})},{threshold:.4}).observe(story);
function layoutHz(){if(mob.matches){hz.style.height='';hzs.style.height='';trk.style.transform='';hz.dataset.t=0;return}var vh=Math.max(innerHeight-78,560),t=Math.max(0,trk.offsetWidth-innerWidth);hzs.style.height=vh+'px';hz.style.height=(vh+t)+'px';hz.dataset.t=t}
var _d=draw;draw=function(){_d();mark('#teams .tc','z');layoutHz()};
addEventListener('resize',layoutHz);addEventListener('load',layoutHz);layoutHz();
setTimeout(window.go,2100);
var hc=D.getElementById('hc'),pitch=D.querySelector('.pitch'),prog=D.getElementById('prog'),hd=D.querySelector('header'),bt=D.querySelector('.bt'),band=D.querySelector('.band'),links=[].slice.call(D.querySelectorAll('.menu a')),secs=['actus','presentation','organisation','equipes','boutique','contact'].map(function(i){return{id:i,el:D.getElementById(i)}});
var mx=0,my=0,cx=0,cy=0,cu=0;
addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){mx=e.clientX/innerWidth*2-1;my=e.clientY/innerHeight*2-1},{passive:true});
function loop(){var sy=scrollY;cx+=(mx-cx)*.06;cy+=(my-cy)*.06;
if(sy<1400){hc.style.transform='translate3d('+cx*18+'px,'+(cy*12+sy*.14)+'px,0) rotateY('+cx*18+'deg) rotateX('+(-cy*12)+'deg) scale('+(1-Math.min(sy/1400,.15))+')';pitch.style.transform='translate3d('+(-cx*12)+'px,'+(-cy*8+sy*.07)+'px,0)'}
var max=H.scrollHeight-innerHeight;prog.style.setProperty('--p',max>0?sy/max:0);
hd.classList.toggle('sc',sy>40);
var r=band.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.bottom>0&&r.top<innerHeight)bt.style.transform='translate3d('+(r.top*.5-900)+'px,0,0)';
var cur='';secs.forEach(function(s){if(s.el.getBoundingClientRect().top<innerHeight*.4)cur=s.id});
links.forEach(function(a){a.classList.toggle('act',a.getAttribute('href')==='#'+cur)});
if(!mob.matches){var hr=hz.getBoundingClientRect(),ht=+hz.dataset.t||0;trk.style.transform='translate3d('+(-(ht>0?Math.min(Math.max((78-hr.top)/ht,0),1):0)*ht)+'px,0,0)';}
requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
loop();

if(matchMedia('(hover:hover)').matches){var tc=null;D.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){var t=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.tc,.pc,.cl a');if(tc&&tc!==t){tc.style.transform='';tc=null}if(!t)return;tc=t;var r=t.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;t.style.transform='perspective(800px) rotateX('+(-y*7)+'deg) rotateY('+(x*7)+'deg) translateY(-4px)'},{passive:true})}
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
